name: Currency Switcher for Easy Digital Downloads
short_description:
Licence: GPL. See all the benefits.

The Currency Switcher for Easy Digital Downloads allows your shop to display prices and accept payments in multiple currencies. This will grant your Visitors the possibility of shopping in their favourite currency, eliminating the costs associated with credit card currency conversions. Should you have any questions about this product, please have a look at the Knowledge Base, or feel free to contact us.

This product is currently not fully compatible with Easy Digital Downloads 3.0. The new version introduces significant changes, and new components that can’t be extended to add multi-currency support. We are discussing this aspect with the Easy Digital Downloads developers, to see if we can find a solution.

Update – June 2021

Due to the complexity of changes, we can’t guarantee that we will be able to add support for Easy Digital Downloads 3.0. For this reason, we decided to suspend the sale of this product, as announced last November. Apologies for any inconvenience caused.

Update – September 2021

We established a collaboration with the EDD Team, to help them develop a multi-currency solution for Easy Digital Downloads 3.0. We’re pleased to announce that the EDD Team has been able to prepare such a solution. We don’t have an exact release date yet, but they informed us that a multi-currency addon for Easy Digital Downloads will soon become available on the official EDD marketplace.
description:
Currency Switcher for Easy Digital Downloads allows your visitors to select in which currency they would like to see your prices, as well as complete transactions in such currency.

How it works

Once enabled, the plugin will allow you to configure a list of the currencies you would like to accept. Such currencies will then appear in a list, displayed as a widget, which your Users can use to choose their preferred currency. When a User selects a currency, the shop will be both displaying prices and completing transactions in the new currency. That is, the prices displayed on the shop will be the ones that the Client will pay upon completing the order.

This feature will enable your shop to receive payments in different currencies, thus reducing the costs deriving from currency conversions performed by the various payment gateways.  Also, credit card operators often charge a conversion fee when a payment is made in a currency different from the one for which the card was issued.

This adds an extra cost on every purchase, and it can discourage prospective clients. giving your Visitors the possibility of paying in their currency can help improving conversion. Every order will store the currency used to place it, so that both Shop Managers and Clients will be able to retrieve it and see how much they paid.

Please Note Your ability to accept payment in each currency will depend on your payment gateway and/or payment processing company, so your Customers will need to complete their purchase in the appropriate currency.

This product includes GeoLite data created by MaxMind, available from http://www.maxmind.com. Releases are announced via blog posts; you can subscribe to the site feed (use the form which you can find on the right, on the front page) to be informed when new updates are available.

Key Features

  • Easy to use for both Site Administrators and End Users.
  • Allows Visitors to shop in their preferred currency.
  • Automatic update of exchange rates, via Open Exchange Rates or WebServiceX.
  • Possibility manually entering a price, in each currency, for each product, without having to use an exchange rate.
  • Automatic detection of Visitors’ Country, with currency set accordingly.
  • Filtering of available payment methods depending on the selected currency.
  • Possibility of setting exchange rates manually, instead of having them updated automatically.
  • Visitors’ preferred currency is persistent and it will be selected automatically at their next visit (feature requires Users to be logged on your shop).
  • Displays orders amounts in both the original currency in which they were placed, and the base one, for quick reference.

Requirements

  • WordPress 4.0 or later.
  • PHP 7.0 or later.
  • PHP Extensions
    • CURL
  • Easy Digital Downloads 2.5 or newer (tested up to EDD 2.9.x).
  • Free Aelia Foundation Classes for Easy Digital Downloads 1.6.1.160110 or newer.
  • Recommended: PHP and WordPress memory limit set to 128MB or more.

name: WooCommerce PayPal Express Extended (Multi-Account)
short_description:
The PayPal Express plugin, for which this addon was designed, has been retired

SkyVerge retired the PayPal Express gateway that our plugin was designed to extend. An alternative plugin has been released by WooCommerce, which is not supported by this PayPal Express Extended solution.

We will evaluate the possibility of supporting the new plugin, or an alternative one such as the PayPal for WooCommerce gateway, in the future. If you wish to know when the new integration will become available, you can follow us on Twitter or Facebook.

Thanks for using the PayPal Express Extended Gateway.

PayPal Express Extended Gateway integrates with our Currency Switcher to add support for multiple PayPal accounts. It allows you to redirect payments to separate PayPal accounts depending on the currency orders are paid in.

Notes

  • This plugin extends the PayPal Express Extended Gateway, developed by SkyVerge, which is required for this extension to work correctly.
  • The multi-account feature provided by this product requires the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce and one or more active PayPal accounts.

Should you have any questions about this product, please feel free to contact us.
description:
PayPal Express Extended Gateway for WooCommerce integrates with the PayPal Express Gateway and the WooCommerce Currency Switcher to allow directing payments to multiple PayPal accounts, depending on the currency used to complete orders.

How it works

The standard PayPal Express gateway, developed by SkyVerge, accepts the API keys of a single PayPal account. This plugin extends the existing gateway, allowing you to enter an API key for each of the currencies enabled in the WooCommerce Currency Switcher. This will allow you to choose a different PayPal account to receive each currency.

Important notes

  • The multi-account feature requires our Currency Switcher for WooCommerce , which must be installed and configured correctly.

PayPal Express Extended Gateway Key Features

  • Seamlessly replaces the existing, robust WooCommerce PayPal Express gateway, developed by SkyVerge. Simply add the API keys for each currency, and you are ready to go, no additional configuration required.
  • Allows to direct payments to multiple PayPal accounts.

Requirements

  • One or more active PayPal account(s).
  • WordPress 3.6 or newer.
  • PHP 5.3 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 2.1.x to 2.6.x.
  • PayPal Express Gateway, by SkyVerge, 3.4.1 or newer.
  • Aelia Currency Switcher 3.6.34.150521 or later.

name: WooCommerce Prices by Country
short_description:
Prices by Country for WooCommerce allows you to charge different prices for each product, depending on customer's country. The plugin includes geolocation features, to automatically detect visitors' country and show the correct prices automatically.

This product is fully compatible with the WooCommerce Currency Switcher. When used together, the two plugins allow to specify multiple prices for each enabled currency and for each configured region, granting unprecedented pricing flexibility.

Please refer to our knowledge base to learn how the Prices by Country and Currency Switcher can work together.

Should you have any questions about this product, please have a look at the Knowledge Base, or feel free to contact us.
description:
Prices by Country for WooCommerce allows set multiple product prices, associated to configurable regions/countries. When a customer visits your site, he will see the prices set for the country from where he connects.

How it works

Once enabled, the plugin will add a new menu item to the WooCommerce menu, which will lead to a page that you can use to configure one or more regions. A region is an arbitrary list of countries: you can create regions with a single country in each, and set product prices for single, specific countries, or regions with multiple countries, and set product prices for that set of countries.

When you will have configured the regions, every product will show additional price fields for each of the regions. By entering a price in these new fields, you will be able to charge a different prices to your customers, depending on which country they will choose at checkout.

The Prices by Country plugin includes a geolocation feature, and it can detect visitors’ location automatically. By doing so, your customers will immediately see the prices that apply to their country, before they reach the checkout.

This product is fully compatible with our WooCommerce Currency Switcher plugin, currently the leading multi-currency solution for WooCommerce. The combination of the two plugins will give you unprecedented flexibility: you will be able to enter different prices in each currency, for each of the regions you configure.

Releases are announced via blog posts; you can subscribe to the site feed (use the form which you can find on the right, on the front page) to be informed when new updates are available.

Key Features

  • Fully compatible with our WooCommerce Currency Switcher plugin. Together, the plugins grant incredible multi-currency, multi-region pricing flexibility.
  • Easy to use for both site Administrators and customers.
  • Allows to set different product prices, depending on customer’s country.
  • Automatically detects visitors’ country, with price set accordingly.
  • Includes a widget to allow your visitors to choose their billing country before they reach checkout.
  • Supports simple, variable, grouped and external products.

Requirements

  • WordPress 3.6 or later.
  • PHP 5.3 or later.
  • WooCommerce 2.4.x to 3.4.x.
  • Free AFC plugin for WooCommerce 1.2.2.141023 or later.
  • WooCommerce Currency Switcher 3.5.7.141030 or later. Optional, required only for multi-currency capabilities.

name: Braintree Extended (Multi-Account + Kount) for WooCommerce
short_description:
This plugin has been acquired by SkyVerge

Both the Multi-account and Kount features provided by our plugin have been included in the official Braintree payment plugin. Starting from version 3.0.0, available since the 10th November 2015, the official gateway will support multiple accounts natively, when used together with our Currency Switcher for WooCommerce.

Braintree Extended (Multi-Account + Kount) Gateway integrates with our Currency Switcher to add support for multiple Braintree merchant accounts. Once configured, it allows to redirect  payments to separate, independent accounts, depending on the currency in which orders are paid.

In addition to the multi-currency support, the gateway also includes the integration with the Kount anti-fraud system provided by Braintree. With one click, you will be able to add advanced fraud protection to your site for all payment processed by Braintree.

Notes

  • This plugin extends the Braintree Gateway developed by SkyVerge, which is required for this extension to work correctly.
  • The multi-account feature provided by this product requires the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce and an active Braintree accounts.
  • The Kount anti-fraud integration feature does not require the Currency Switcher.

Should you have any questions about this product, please have a look at the Knowledge Base, or feel free to contact us.
description:
Braintree Extended Gateway for WooCommerce integrates with the standard Braintree Payment Gateway and the Currency Switcher to allow directing payments to multiple accounts, depending on the currency used to complete orders. This plugin also includes integration with the Kount anti-fraud system provided by Braintree.

How it works

The standard Braintree gateway, developed by SkyVerge, accepts the details of only one Braintree account. This plugin extends the existing Braintree gateway, allowing to enter the details of one account for each of the currencies enabled in the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce.

Another key feature of the Braintree Extended Gateway is the integration with Kount. By enabling the Advanced Fraud Protection on your account and the integration in the gateway settings, you will receive additional protections against fraudulent transactions. The gateway supports both Kount basic and Kount Direct integrations.

Important notes

  • The multi-account feature requires the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce , which must be installed and configured correctly.
  • The Kount anti-fraud integration works with our without the Currency Switcher installed.

Braintree Extended Gateway Key Features

  • Seamlessly replaces Braintree Standard gateway. Simply add the account details and you are ready to go, no additional configuration required.
  • Allows to direct payments to multiple Braintree merchant accounts.
  • Kount integration offers additional protection against fraudulent transactions.
  • Extends existing, robust gateway developed by SkyVerge.

Requirements

  • An active account. If you wish to use the multi-account feature, you will just have to contact Braintree Support to get the merchant IDs.
  • WordPress 3.6 or later.
  • PHP 5.3 or later.
  • WooCommerce 2.1.x/2.2.x/2.3.x/2.4.x.
  • Aelia Foundation Classes 1.2.2.141023 or later.
  • Braintree Gateway, by SkyVerge, v2.1.3 or later.
  • For the multi-account feature: Aelia Currency Switcher 3.5.6.141023 or later.

name: WooCommerce Mijireh Multi-Currency
short_description:
This addon has been retired

The purpose of the addon was to ensure that the Mijireh payment gateway processed orders in the correct currency. The Mijireh Checkout gateway for WooCommerce is no longer available, therefore we decided to retire this addon.

Mijireh Multi-Currency Gateway integrates with our Currency Switcher to add support for multiple currencies to the standard Mijireh gateway included with WooCommerce.

Notes

  • This product requires the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce, and a separate Mijireh store for each currency you would like to accept through the gateway. Please contact Mijireh Support Team to enquiry about the costs of running multiple stores. See full requirements below.
  • Note: this free plugin does not include support. Should you need support, you can contact us to request a consultation (hourly rates apply).

Should you have any questions about this product, please have a look at the Knowledge Base, or feel free to contact us.
description:
Mijireh Multi-Currency Gateway for WooCommerce adds multi-currency features to WooCommerce standard Mijireh gateway.

How it works

By design, Mijireh servers can only accept payments in the currency you select when you configure your store. That is, the servers have a “one store = one currency” rule. To bypass this limitation, it’s necessary to create multiple stores, but the standard gateway included in WooCommerce can only handle one of them.

The Mijireh Multi-Currency Gateway solves this issue, by creating one virtual gateway for each currency you enable in the Currency Switcher. You will then be able to configure each one separately, and route payments to the correct store, depending on which currency in which orders are placed.

Important notes

  • To work properly, this product requires the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce, and a separate Mijireh store for each currency you would like to accept through the gateway. Please contact the Mijireh Support Team to enquiry about the costs of running multiple stores. See full requirements below.
  • For an overview of how to install and configure this product, please refer to the installation instructions.
  • This free product does not include support. Should you need support, you can purchase such service from our shop.

Key Features

  • Easy to configure.
  • Allows to accept multiple currencies via Mijireh.
  • Allows to accept credit cards on your site without having to install an SSL certificate.
  • Thanks to Page Slurp feature, payment interface will look exactly like your site.
  • Built on existing, robust WooCommerce Mijireh gateway.

Requirements

  • An active Mijireh account, with a separate store for each currency that should be accepted through the gateway.
  • WordPress 3.6 or later.
  • PHP 5.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce 2.4.x to 3.2.x.
  • Free Aelia Foundation Classes 1.0.11.140825 or newer.
  • Aelia Currency Switcher 3.4.17.140903 or newer.

Installation instructions

You can find full installation instructions in our knowledge base: Multi-currency Mijireh gateway – Installation instructions.

description:

When prices are entered manually, they are used whenever the corresponding currency is used during checkout, instead of relying on their calculation using exchange rates.

How it works

Once enabled, the plugin will automatically extend the supported shipping methods and add an interface that will allow you to set prices in each currency.

Releases are announced via blog posts; you can subscribe to the site feed (use the form which you can find on the right, on the front page) to be informed when new updates are available.

  • One click setup: it will work automatically, as soon as it’s activated, by extending all the supported shipping methods.
  • Allows to enter shipping prices in each of the currencies enabled in the Currency Switcher for WooCommerce.
  • Supports the Table Rate Shipping plugin, by Bolder Elements.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 3.0.x or newer.

Should you have any questions about this product, please have a look at the Knowledge Base, or feel free to contact us.
description:
Currency Switcher for Easy Digital Downloads allows your visitors to select in which currency they would like to see your prices, as well as complete transactions in such currency.

How it works

Once enabled, the plugin will allow you to configure a list of the currencies you would like to accept. Such currencies will then appear in a list, displayed as a widget, which your Users can use to choose their preferred currency. When a User selects a currency, the shop will be both displaying prices and completing transactions in the new currency. That is, the prices displayed on the shop will be the ones that the Client will pay upon completing the order.

This feature will enable your shop to receive payments in different currencies, thus reducing the costs deriving from currency conversions performed by the various payment gateways.  Also, credit card operators often charge a conversion fee when a payment is made in a currency different from the one for which the card was issued.

This adds an extra cost on every purchase, and it can discourage prospective clients. giving your Visitors the possibility of paying in their currency can help improving conversion. Every order will store the currency used to place it, so that both Shop Managers and Clients will be able to retrieve it and see how much they paid.

Please Note Your ability to accept payment in each currency will depend on your payment gateway and/or payment processing company, so your Customers will need to complete their purchase in the appropriate currency.

This product includes GeoLite data created by MaxMind, available from http://www.maxmind.com. Releases are announced via blog posts; you can subscribe to the site feed (use the form which you can find on the right, on the front page) to be informed when new updates are available.

Key Features

  • Easy to use for both Site Administrators and End Users.
  • Allows Visitors to shop in their preferred currency.
  • Automatic update of exchange rates, via Open Exchange Rates or WebServiceX.
  • Possibility manually entering a price, in each currency, for each product, without having to use an exchange rate.
  • Automatic detection of Visitors’ Country, with currency set accordingly.
  • Filtering of available payment methods depending on the selected currency.
  • Possibility of setting exchange rates manually, instead of having them updated automatically.
  • Visitors’ preferred currency is persistent and it will be selected automatically at their next visit (feature requires Users to be logged on your shop).
  • Displays orders amounts in both the original currency in which they were placed, and the base one, for quick reference.

Requirements

  • WordPress 3.6 or later.
  • PHP 5.4 or later.
  • PHP Extensions
    • CURL
  • Easy Digital Downloads 2.1 or later.
  • Aelia Foundation Classes for Easy Digital Downloads 1.0.12.140908 or later.
  • Recommended: PHP and WordPress memory limit set to 128MB or more.

This product has been retired and is no longer supported.

Skrill Gateway for WooCommerce adds support for Skrill (Moneybookers) to the available payment methods. By enabling it, your customer will be able to complete payments through a secure portal.
description:
Skrill Gateway for WooCommerce allows your Customers to pay through Skrill (Moneybookers).

How it works

The plugin will add a new payment gateway called Skrill (Moneybookers), which will add support for the Skrill payment gateway. Upon checkout, your customers will be redirected to a secure portal where they can complete their payment. Both standard and Quick Checkout modes are supported.

Skrill Features

  • All major credit and debit cards accepted.
  • Instant authorisation. Transactions are confirmed and settled immediately.
  • Multiple currencies accepted.
  • PCI compliant gateway. You won’t need to worry about implementing PCI compliance on your site.
  • Easy to set up and configure.

Key Features of Skrill Gateway plugin

  • Supports both standard and Quick Checkout modes (you must ask Skrill to enable Quick Checkout on your account if you wish to use it).
  • Easy to configure.
  • Redirects the user to the Skrill portal in the appropriate language (WPML required)
  • Fully compatible with the Currency Switcher, to accept payments in multiple currencies.
  • Redirects your Customers to Skrill website to complete payment, so you won’t have to worry about handling, storing and processing credit cards details.

Requirements

  • An active Skrill Merchant account.
  • WordPress 3.6 or newer.
  • PHP 5.4 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 2.4.x or newer.

Installation instructions

  1. Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payment Gateways > Skrill to configure the plugin.

For more information about installation and management of plugins, please refer to WordPress documentation.

Setup

On the settings page, the following settings are required:

  • Skrill Email: this is the email address associated to your merchant account.
  • Secret Word: this is the secret word you entered in your account settings.

If you wish to get more details about the settings and where to find them, please refer to Skrill website.

Integration with Currency Switcher

This plugin is fully compatible with the Currency Switcher. If you are using the Currency Switcher, and you find out that the Skrill gateway is not appearing on the checkout page, please go to WooCommerce > Currency Switcher Options > Payment Gateways and make sure that Skrill is listed amongst the Enabled Gateways.

Product Support

This product is provided free of charge as-is, and it’s not covered by free support. Paid support is available. For more details, see the support section of our terms and conditions.

name: Awards (Badges) for Vanilla Forums 2.0
short_description:
Awards (Badges) Plugin for  Vanilla Forums 2.0 introduces gamification to your self hosted forum. Thanks to its flexible engine, it supports virtually unlimited Awards/Badges, and just as many Rules that can be used to award them. Additionally, the plugin supports Award Classes, and it includes a sample, basic Rule that you can use to develop your own.

With many features and an intuitive User Interface, adding Badges to your self-hosted Vanilla Forums will be a breeze!
description:
Awards/Badges Plugin adds gamification features to your self-hosted Vanilla Forum, by allowing you to create Badges and assign them to Users based on a combination of criteria. The plugin supports virtually unlimited Badges, and each Badge is fully configurable, both in terms of look and in terms of assignment criteria.

Main Features

Support for Award Classes

A feature unique to this plugin is the support for Award Classes. You can use them to group the Awards/Badges in Classes and let your Users understand which ones are the easiest to get, and which ones require more effort. With Classes, you are no longer limited to a flat list of Badges.

Support for unlimited, customisable Awards/Badges

You can configure as many Awards/Badges as you need and customise them as you wish. Award names, classes, descriptions, images, scores and assignment rules are fully configurable.

Awards/Badges tracking

The plugin uses Vanilla’s database to persist them and keep track of the Users who earned them. You don’t have to worry about the time required to process the Awards: processing occur after the main content has been delivered to the User. Besides, when a User earns an Award, such event is recorded, so that the same Award won’t be processed twice, effectively reducing the amount of data to process.

Flexible and Extensible Rules System

The Awards Plugin implements a flexible Rule system, which can support as many rules as you may need. While the plugin is supplied with several Core rules, you can create new ones to fit your needs, and even override existing ones.

Creating new Rules is straightforward. You can use the included Sample Rule as a guideline, then copy your brand new rule in rules/core directory. The plugin will automatically pick it up, and it will be ready for you to use.

We also provide a Rule development service, for when you don’t have the time or skills to develop one yourself. If you wish to have a custom Rule created for you, please contact us, and we will get back to you with a quote.

Several Rules included

The plugin provides the following Rules, out of the box:

  • Anniversary. Checks User’s Anniversary of Registration general user core/anniversaryrule.
  • Likes. Checks the amount of “Likes” received by the User general content core/likesrule.
  • Photogenic. Checks if User uploaded a Profile Picture general user core/photogenicrule.
  • Post Count. Checks User’s Post count general content core/postcountrule.
  • QnA (Questions & Answers) Checks the “Accepted Answers” that the User has given or received general content core/qnarule.
  • Thanks. Checks “Thanks” received by the User general content core/thanksrule.
  • User Roles. Checks if a User has one or more Roles general user core/userrolesrule.

Additionally, a Sample Rule is provided to illustrate how to develop new ones.

Integration with Vanilla’s Activity and Notification system

Every time a User earns an Award/Badge, the event is recorded in Vanilla’s Activity, and Users are notified of it by email and/or by a pop-up message on the forum itself. Notifications can be turned off by Users, if they wish.

Import/Export of Awards and Award Classes

An interface will be implemented to import and export Awards and Awards Classes with a few clicks. This will allow the creation of Award Sets which can be easily moved from one site to another, or distributed for 3rd party use.

Requirements

  • PHP 5.3+
  • Vanilla Forums 2.0 (plugin has not been tested on Vanilla 2.1)
  • Logger Plugin 13.02.01 or newer (either Basic or Advanced version)
  • Aelia Foundation Classes 13.04.26 or newer

description:
Hot Threads Plugin for Vanilla Forums 2.0/2.1 displays a list of the Discussions that received the highest amount of Views and/or Comments.

How it works

Once enabled, the Plugin will add a widget to the Sidebar (Panel), displaying a short list of the Hot Discussions. The content of the widget will automatically refresh at a constant interval. At the same time, a new link, named Hot, will be added to the Discussions Menu. Such link will open a full page with the list of the Hot Discussions.

The Plugin determines which Discussions are hot based on the Views and/or Comments they received. As soon as a Discussion reaches the configured thresholds, it will be automatically picked up by the plugin and displayed in both the Hot Threads widget and page.

Key Features

  • Displays a list of Hot Threads in a Widget and in a full featured page.
  • Zero configuration needed to get started. Plugin works out of the box, configuration has to be modified only if needed.
  • Compatible with both Vanilla 2.0 and 2.1b (see Notes)

Requirements

  • PHP 5.3+
  • Vanilla Forums 2.0/2.1b (see Notes)

Notes

  • Plugin has been tested on Vanilla 2.1b and it should be compatible with it. However, since Vanilla 2.1 is still in Beta, compatibility cannot be guaranteed. For the same reason, we provide limited assistance for installation in such environment.
  • Hot Discussions Widget and Page have been tested on Vanilla default theme. While they should be working with other themes, compatibility with them is not guaranteed and may require some adjustments.

description:
Post Scheduler for Vanilla Forums 2.0/2.1b gives you the possibility of scheduling Discussions and Announcements to be displayed to your Users at a later date and time.

How it works

The plugin modifies the interface used to add or edit a Discussion, and adds a field that allows you to schedule the post to become visible to other Users at a later date and time. To make things easier, the scheduler implements a JavaScript date/time picker, so that selecting the date and time is just a matter of a few clicks.

Once a Discussion is scheduled, only the following Users will be able to see it before its scheduled time:

  • The User who started the discussion.
  • Super Administrators.
  • Any User with the permission to see all Scheduled discussions.

Everyone else will simply not see it anywhere, until the time comes.

Key Features

  • Zero configuration needed. Plugin works out of the box.
  • Intuitive User Interface. Scheduled Discussions are highlighted to easily recognise them before they go live (see Notes).
  • Convenient list of current User’s scheduled Discussions is displayed amongst the Discussion tabs.
  • No need to schedule Cron jobs or timed tasks: Discussions will appear automatically at the specified date and time.
  • Integration with Logger Plugin for Vanilla, for easier debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Delays delivery of Notifications related to new Discussions (from version 13.02.25).
  • Compatible with both Vanilla 2.0 and 2.1b (see Notes)

Requirements

  • PHP 5.3+
  • Vanilla Forums 2.0/2.1b (see Notes)
  • Logger Plugin 13.02.01 or newer must be installed and enabled
  • Aelia Foundation Classes 13.02.27 or newer

Notes

  • Plugin has been tested on Vanilla 2.1b and it should be compatible with it. However, since Vanilla 2.1 is still in Beta, compatibility cannot be guaranteed. For the same reason, we provide limited assistance for installation in such environment.
  • As of version 13.02.25, plugin also delays the delivery of notifications related to new Discussions. Please note that such feature, on Vanilla 2.1, is experimental and could have some issues. This is due to the new mechanism that such version uses to manage notifications, which is still incomplete and contains several bugs.
  • Highlighting of scheduled Discussions has been designed for Vanilla’s default theme. Using the plugin with 3rd party themes might require some adjustment to the plugin’s CSS files.
  • Important: this plugin requires some modifications to Vanilla Core files. Such changes are made automatically, in a non-permanent way when the plugin is enabled, and don’t affect normal operations even when the plugin is disabled.
    If you wish to ensure that every modification to Core files is removed when the plugin is disabled, simply remove all ini files from cache folder and its subfolders.

name: Steam™ Sign In Plugin for Vanilla Forums 2.0
short_description: Steam ™ Sign In Plugin adds the possibility, for the visitors of your Forum, to register and log in using their Steam ™ ID. Authentication is performed directly on Steam ™ Servers, and communication with your forum is done securely using OpenID.
description:
This plugin allows your Users to register and log in on your forum using their Steam ™ identity. It uses OpenID plugin built-in in Vanilla Forums to communicate with Steam OpenID Server, which takes care of handling User’s credentials.

Note

Vanilla’s OpenID plugin has a bug. When Users register to the forum passing through Steam (or any OpenID provider who doesn’t return a User Name and an Email address for the User), they are prompted to enter the User Name and Email Address they wish to use on the forum. However, when they do so, the Email address is accidentally deleted before the registration occurs. This results in the error message “Email is required” being displayed to the User and the registration failing. The issue is being discussed on Vanilla Community, but it doesn’t have an official solution, as of November 2012.

Unofficial fix for the OpenID plugin issue

Important: this fix is unofficial and it has not been provided by Vanilla Team. Use it at your risk.

  1. Find file class.openid.plugin.php in your Vanilla installation directory.
  2. In the file, find the following code: 
    $Form->SetFormValue('FullName', GetValue('namePerson/first', $Attr) . ' ' . GetValue('namePerson/last', $Attr)); 
$Form->SetFormValue('Email', GetValue('contact/email', $Attr));
  3. Replace the code with the following: 
    if($Form->GetValue('FullName', null) == null) { 
  $Form->SetFormValue('FullName', GetValue('namePerson/first', $Attr).' '.GetValue('namePerson/last', $Attr));
}
if($Form->GetValue('Email', null) == null) {
  $Form->SetFormValue('Email', GetValue('contact/email', $Attr));
}

The new code simply checks if the fields already contain a value before overwriting them. Since they are not empty after the User entered his details, they won’t get overwritten anymore.

Requirements

  • PHP 5.3+
  • Vanilla Forums 2.0

name: LoginGuard for Vanilla Forums 2.0
short_description:
LoginGuard for Vanilla 2.0 monitors logins and keeps track of failed attempts. When too many failures are detected for the same User, LoginGuard throttles it, effectively rendering brute force attacks useless.

For additional protection, LoginGuard supports progressively increasing ban durations, and it’s fully integrated with both Basic and Advanced Logger for Vanilla 2.0.
description:
LoginGuard for Vanilla Forums 2.0 improves the security of your Community, by keeping track of failed login attempts and throttling them, greatly reducing the chances of hacking via brute force attacks.

How it works

Once the Plugin is configured, Users will have a limited amount of attempts to log in. Every time a Users will enter the wrong credentials, his attempt will be logged via Logger plugin for Vanilla (either Basic or Advanced version) and, once reached the set limit, the User will be temporarily banned (this condition is also called throttling).

In such case, any login attempt for the banned User will be simply rejected, for a set period. Any brute force attack will fail, and so will any attempt to log in with the correct credentials. When the ban will expire, login requests for the User will be accepted again.

Key Features

  • Easy to configure.
  • Convenient Administration interface to view the banned Users and manually remove bans.
  • Integration with Logger Plugin for Vanilla, for automatic logging all failed attempts, bans and suspicious activities.
  • Support for incremental ban duration (multiple bans in a set period will result in a longer ban period).

Requirements

  • PHP 5.3+
  • Vanilla Forums 2.0
  • Logger Plugin for Vanilla (either Basic or Advanced version) must be installed and enabled

name: Logger for Vanilla Forums 2.0/2.1b
short_description: Advanced Logger adds logging capabilities to Vanilla Forums 2.0. It has been designed to allow 3rd party plugins to easily log messages to one or multiple destinations, by taking advantage of the flexibility offered by of Apache Log4php.
description:
Running a Community is a time consuming task, which will become more demanding as the Community grows. Unfortunately, together with your Users, issues may start increasing in numbers. Crashes, slow performances, unexpected behaviour, they are all way too common, it’s rare to meet an Administrator who doesn’t have to deal with them on a regular basis.

What’s worse, most of these issues seem to arise while Administrators were not available. That means they have to attempt reproducing them in a test environment, which rarely reflects the same conditions in which the problems occurred in the first place. If that weren’t enough, the only information available to the Administrators is what they got from the Users, because Vanilla Forums doesn’t have a standard logging mechanism built-in.

Advanced Logger for Vanilla Forums aims to cover that gap, by providing a flexible way of logging information to one or more destinations. Based on the popular Apache Log4php library, Advanced Logger goes beyond the usual text file based logging, and supports table-based logs, email logs and, best of all, remote, centralized log services such as PaperTrail, Loggly and Graylog2.

Key Features

  • Support for several different types of destinations:
    • Database
    • PaperTrail
    • Loggly
    • Graylog2
    • Remote Syslog
    • File
    • Echo
    • And more to come
  • Virtually unlimited amount of configurable destinations.
  • Very fast. Logging the same message to a dozen different destinations takes less than a second.
  • Easy to use. Adding the first logging to your code requires just two lines of code.
  • Compatible with Vanilla Forums 2.1b (see Notes)

All the above, for the cost of just one hour of your Administrators’ time!

Requirements

  • PHP 5.3+
  • Vanilla Forums 2.0/2.1b

Notes

  • Plugin has been tested on Vanilla 2.1b and it should be compatible with it. However, since Vanilla 2.1 is still in Beta, compatibility cannot be guaranteed. For the same reason, we provide limited assistance for installation in such environment.
